dialogues.jp:
テーブルにのっそりと身体を広げながら、ぼ〜っ
とマンガを読む。
dialogues.en:
I was reading a manga magazine as I spread myself over the
table.
dialogues.text:
I was reading a manga magazine as I spread myself over the
table.

dialogues.jp:
たまに口元が寂しくなった時は、手から和菓子
を生み出してほっぽり込む。
dialogues.en: And whenever my mouth got lonely, I threw a snack into it.
dialogues.text: And whenever my mouth got lonely, I threw a snack into it.

dialogues.jp: 「最高ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't this the best?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't this the best?"

dialogues.jp:
なぜか疑問形にしてしまうくらい、まったりと
した午後だった。
dialogues.en:
It was such a mellow afternoon, I had to ask myself a
question.
dialogues.text:
It was such a mellow afternoon, I had to ask myself a
question.

dialogues.jp:
いつもなら、ようやく授業から解放されて、残
り少ない時間でなにをしようかと考えていると
ころだが……。
dialogues.en:
It was about the time to finish school, and I'd be thinking
about what I can do the rest of the day.
dialogues.text:
It was about the time to finish school, and I'd be thinking
about what I can do the rest of the day.

dialogues.jp:
「つまり、これだけだらけていても、まだ色々
　と時間があるわけだ」
dialogues.en: "So, that means, I can waste much more time."
dialogues.text: "So, that means, I can waste much more time."

dialogues.jp: これは、なかなか新鮮な雰囲気だ。
dialogues.en: This was so refreshing.
dialogues.text: This was so refreshing.

dialogues.jp: 思わず笑みがこぼれる。
dialogues.en: I smiled without noticing.
dialogues.text: I smiled without noticing.

dialogues.jp:
なにか、それほどひどくない風邪で休んでいる
日みたいだな。
dialogues.en:
It's kind of like skipping school when you get a cold, but
only it's not really a bad cold, or something.
dialogues.text:
It's kind of like skipping school when you get a cold, but
only it's not really a bad cold, or something.

dialogues.jp: ――ガタガタ。
dialogues.en: Clatter clatter.
dialogues.text: Clatter clatter.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よいしょっと」
dialogues.en: "Hold on."
dialogues.text: "Hold on."

dialogues.jp:
マンガから顔を上げると、さくらが窓からベッ
ドの上に着地しているところだった。
dialogues.en:
I looked up and then I saw Sakura landing on my bed from the
window.
dialogues.text:
I looked up and then I saw Sakura landing on my bed from the
window.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うたまるはココで大人しくしてるんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "Wait right here, Utamaru."
dialogues.text: "Wait right here, Utamaru."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、こけしにしか見えない白猫を窓辺
に置いて、さくらがテコテコと寄ってきた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura placed the white cat by the window and came closer to
me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura placed the white cat by the window and came closer to
me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おいっす！」
dialogues.en: "Hey you!"
dialogues.text: "Hey you!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それはいいんだが……やっぱり俺は、
　あの猫の造形はおかしいと思うのだが？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, right...... You know, I just can't get over how that
cat looks, what do you think?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, right...... You know, I just can't get over how that
cat looks, what do you think?"

dialogues.jp:
この家の主だとでもいいたげに、断りなく対面
に座るさくらに首を傾げる。
dialogues.en:
I tilted my head toward Sakura who was acting like this was
her house.
dialogues.text:
I tilted my head toward Sakura who was acting like this was
her house.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　そう？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? You think?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? You think?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あきらかに、神の領域に突入してるだろ……」
dialogues.en: "It must be made by God's hand......"
dialogues.text: "It must be made by God's hand......"

dialogues.jp: 自力歩行できるのかアレは？
dialogues.en: Can it walk by itself?
dialogues.text: Can it walk by itself?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことより、春休みだよ春休み♪」
dialogues.en: "It's spring break, you know? Spring break!"
dialogues.text: "It's spring break, you know? Spring break!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あの存在は、そんなことレベルか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't care about the existence of that thing?"
dialogues.text: "You don't care about the existence of that thing?"

dialogues.jp:
うたまるは、窓辺でメトロノームのように首を
揺らしている。
dialogues.en: Utamaru's swaying her head like a metronome by the window.
dialogues.text: Utamaru's swaying her head like a metronome by the window.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、そうだな……気にしたら夜眠れなくな
　りそうだし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I guess if you start thinking about it, you wouldn't
be able to go to sleep at night..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I guess if you start thinking about it, you wouldn't
be able to go to sleep at night..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「で、春休みなんだってば！」
dialogues.en: "You hear? It's spring break!!"
dialogues.text: "You hear? It's spring break!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、遠い道のりだった」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it was a long road."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it was a long road."

dialogues.jp: 思わずしみじみと頷いてしまう。
dialogues.en: I nodded with deep emotion.
dialogues.text: I nodded with deep emotion.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うんうん♪　というわけで、遊びに行こう
　よ！」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes. And I think we should go out!!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes. And I think we should go out!!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Meow!"
dialogues.text: "Meow!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「え、今からか？」
dialogues.en: "What? Right now?"
dialogues.text: "What? Right now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まだ４時だよ。アフターフォー。全然オッ　
　ケー。ノープロブレム。行こうってんだほ
　らぁ！」
dialogues.en:
"It's only 4 o'clock. It's only four o'clock and there's no
problem. Let's go, I say!!"
dialogues.text:
"It's only 4 o'clock. It's only four o'clock and there's no
problem. Let's go, I say!!"

dialogues.jp: 腕をひっぱりながら、さくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiled as she pulled my arm.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiled as she pulled my arm.

dialogues.jp: 「待て、今日くらいゆっくりしないか？」
dialogues.en: "Wait, let's take it easy today, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Wait, let's take it easy today, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、もったいないよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Why? You're wasting a day."
dialogues.text: "Why? You're wasting a day."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、待て」
dialogues.en: "Wait, hold on."
dialogues.text: "Wait, hold on."

dialogues.jp:
手でさくらを制しながら、眉にしわを寄せて首
を振る。
dialogues.en: I shook my head frowning as I stopped Sakura with my hand.
dialogues.text: I shook my head frowning as I stopped Sakura with my hand.

dialogues.jp:
「日々、学園というコロシアムで戦い続けてい
　る戦士には、束の間でも休息は必要だと思う
　ぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"I think we soldiers who fight in the coliseum called school
should rest once in a while, don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"I think we soldiers who fight in the coliseum called school
should rest once in a while, don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに頑張ってるの？」
dialogues.en: "You fight that hard?"
dialogues.text: "You fight that hard?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「朝起きたり、授業中寝ないようにしたり、混
　んでいる購買でパンを買うときは命がけだな」
dialogues.en:
"It's a life and death situation every time I wake up in the
morning, and try not to sleep during the class, or buying a
sandwich in the crowded store at school."
dialogues.text:
"It's a life and death situation every time I wake up in the
morning, and try not to sleep during the class, or buying a
sandwich in the crowded store at school."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「勉強しなよ……」
dialogues.en: "You better study......"
dialogues.text: "You better study......"

dialogues.jp: ジト目で｛にら／睨｝まれる。
dialogues.en: She glared at me.
dialogues.text: She glared at me.

dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、今日くらいゆっくりしたいんだ」
dialogues.en: "I just want to be mellow today."
dialogues.text: "I just want to be mellow today."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃぁ……仕方ない。ま、こうやってお兄ちゃ
　んとまったりするのも良いか」
dialogues.en:
"Meow...... that's too bad. I guess it shouldn't be bad to
chill out with you like this."
dialogues.text:
"Meow...... that's too bad. I guess it shouldn't be bad to
chill out with you like this."

dialogues.jp:
机の上にべた〜っとへばって、さくらが顔を丸
くする。
dialogues.en: She sat on my desk and smiled.
dialogues.text: She sat on my desk and smiled.

dialogues.jp: さわさわ、と風が桜をなでる音が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I hear the wind blowing over the cherry blossom tree.
dialogues.text: I hear the wind blowing over the cherry blossom tree.

dialogues.jp: 「春だな」
dialogues.en: "It's spring time."
dialogues.text: "It's spring time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「春だねぇ」
dialogues.en: "It sure is spring time."
dialogues.text: "It sure is spring time."

dialogues.jp: まったりとした空気。
dialogues.en: Really chilled atmosphere.
dialogues.text: Really chilled atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへ。お兄ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもない。呼んだだけだよ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing. I just called your name."
dialogues.text: "Nothing. I just called your name."

dialogues.jp: 机の上で頬杖をついて、さくらが呟く。
dialogues.en:
Sakura mumbles as she rests her chin on her hand on the
desk.
dialogues.text:
Sakura mumbles as she rests her chin on her hand on the
desk.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか――そう、昔のさくらとふたりだけで
居る時は、こんな感じだったような気がした。
dialogues.en:
Yes, it was like this when we used to hang out together a
long time ago...
dialogues.text:
Yes, it was like this when we used to hang out together a
long time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「懐かしいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I missed this."
dialogues.text: "I missed this."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんだかノスタルジック……甘く切なく懐か
　しい、っていうかなんていうか」
dialogues.en: "It's kind of nostalgic...... It's bittersweet, you know?"
dialogues.text: "It's kind of nostalgic...... It's bittersweet, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah?"

dialogues.jp:
同じことを考えていたのもシャクで、つい素っ
気無く答えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I was thinking about the same thing, so I had to say
something opposite.
dialogues.text:
I was thinking about the same thing, so I had to say
something opposite.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃにゃ〜？」
dialogues.en: "Meow meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow meow?"

dialogues.jp: 生物の進化に疑問を投げかける猫が鳴く。
dialogues.en:
The cat which throws a question to Darwin's theory of
evolution meows.
dialogues.text:
The cat which throws a question to Darwin's theory of
evolution meows.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふぅん。えへへへへ」
dialogues.en: "I see. Teehee."
dialogues.text: "I see. Teehee."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだお前？」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん……ちょうだい」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan, give it to me..."
dialogues.text: "Oniichan, give it to me..."

dialogues.jp: 机に身をのりだして、さくらが唇を指差す。
dialogues.en: Sakura points to her finger as she leans forward.
dialogues.text: Sakura points to her finger as she leans forward.

dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、久しぶりに」
dialogues.en: "It's been a long time."
dialogues.text: "It's been a long time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「は？　……ちょっと待て」
dialogues.en: "What? ......Hold on."
dialogues.text: "What? ......Hold on."

dialogues.jp: こめかみに指を当てて必死に思い返してみる。
dialogues.en: I put my fingers at my temple and try to think back.
dialogues.text: I put my fingers at my temple and try to think back.

dialogues.jp: ちょうだい？
dialogues.en: Give it to me?
dialogues.text: Give it to me?

dialogues.jp: 久しぶり？
dialogues.en: It's been a long time?
dialogues.text: It's been a long time?

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりにちょうだい……。
dialogues.en: It's been a long time, give it to me......
dialogues.text: It's been a long time, give it to me......

dialogues.jp: 若気の至り？
dialogues.en: A youthful impetuosity?
dialogues.text: A youthful impetuosity?

dialogues.jp: 「まったく覚えがない……」
dialogues.en: "I really don't remember......"
dialogues.text: "I really don't remember......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なるべく柔らかくて甘いのがいいな♪」
dialogues.en: "Make it soft and sweet."
dialogues.text: "Make it soft and sweet."

dialogues.jp: パチンと指を弾いて、そのまま手を握って開く。
dialogues.en: I snapped my finger and closed my hand and opened it.
dialogues.text: I snapped my finger and closed my hand and opened it.

dialogues.jp: 「……今のわざとだろう？」
dialogues.en: "......You did that on purpose."
dialogues.text: "......You did that on purpose."

dialogues.jp:
生み出した小粒の饅頭を、さくらの唇に押し付
けてうめく。
dialogues.en:
I made a small sweet rice cake and pushed it against her
lips.
dialogues.text:
I made a small sweet rice cake and pushed it against her
lips.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あはははははは♪」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「はてさて？　ボクは｛・・・／どっち｝でも良かったんだ
　けどね」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know. I wouldn't have minded either of them
though."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know. I wouldn't have minded either of them
though."

dialogues.jp:
笑って、俺の指に唇を押し付けて饅頭を口にす
る。
dialogues.en:
She smiled and pushed her lips against my finger and ate the
sweet rice cake.
dialogues.text:
She smiled and pushed her lips against my finger and ate the
sweet rice cake.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、あのなぁ……そんなことばっかしてると、
　いつか狼に食べられちまうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You know...... If you keep doing that, then the bad wolf's
going to eat you."
dialogues.text:
"You know...... If you keep doing that, then the bad wolf's
going to eat you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクあかずきんちゃん。お兄ちゃんが狼？」
dialogues.en: "I'm a little red riding-hood. And you're the wolf?"
dialogues.text: "I'm a little red riding-hood. And you're the wolf?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まずそうやなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "You look unappetizing......"
dialogues.text: "You look unappetizing......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｗｈａｔ？　なにそれ！？」
dialogues.en: "What? What do you mean!?"
dialogues.text: "What? What do you mean!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そのまんまだ」
dialogues.en: "Just like I said."
dialogues.text: "Just like I said."

dialogues.jp: マンガに視線を戻して呟く。
dialogues.en: I looked at the manga magazine again and mumbled.
dialogues.text: I looked at the manga magazine again and mumbled.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！　なにそれ、喧嘩売ってる？」
dialogues.en: "Meow! What's that? Do you want to fight me?"
dialogues.text: "Meow! What's that? Do you want to fight me?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Meow!"
dialogues.text: "Meow!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「ふっ」
dialogues.en: "Huh."
dialogues.text: "Huh."

dialogues.jp: 苦笑いを浮かべながら肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: I shrugged my shoulders smiling wryly.
dialogues.text: I shrugged my shoulders smiling wryly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあさ……どんな味がするか、なんなら試
　してみる？」
dialogues.en:
"Then, do you want to try to find out if I'm really
unappetizing or not?"
dialogues.text:
"Then, do you want to try to find out if I'm really
unappetizing or not?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 思わず素で動きを止めてしまう。
dialogues.en: I stopped moving.
dialogues.text: I stopped moving.

dialogues.jp:
顔を上げると、さくらがじっ、と俺を見つめて
いた……。
dialogues.en: I looked up and found Sakura looking into my eyes......
dialogues.text: I looked up and found Sakura looking into my eyes......

dialogues.jp: ――冗談。
dialogues.en: ---I was just joking.
dialogues.text: ---I was just joking.

dialogues.jp:
そう言おうと思うのだが、机にのりだしたさく
らの真剣な瞳がそれを制する。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to say that, but Sakura's serious look demanded me
not to say that as she leaned against the desk.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to say that, but Sakura's serious look demanded me
not to say that as she leaned against the desk.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……ボク……いいよ。向こうでも唇だけはさ
　せなかったし……」
dialogues.en:
"......I don't mind. I didn't let anyone touch my lips in
America......"
dialogues.text:
"......I don't mind. I didn't let anyone touch my lips in
America......"

dialogues.jp: そうか。
dialogues.en: I see.
dialogues.text: I see.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの外見は変わっていないが、こいつの中
身はきちんと成長しているんだ……。
dialogues.en: Sakura's looks haven't changed, but she's matured inside.
dialogues.text: Sakura's looks haven't changed, but she's matured inside.

dialogues.jp: ふたりの間には机があって。
dialogues.en: There was a desk in between us.
dialogues.text: There was a desk in between us.

dialogues.jp:
さくらだけが身を乗り出してキスすることは出
来ない。
dialogues.en: We couldn't kiss just as Sakura leaning toward me.
dialogues.text: We couldn't kiss just as Sakura leaning toward me.

dialogues.jp:
ここに来て、ようやく自分の間違いに気が付い
た。
dialogues.en: I realize my mistake at this moment finally.
dialogues.text: I realize my mistake at this moment finally.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だ、大丈夫……ボクも初めてだから」
dialogues.en: "It's okay...... It's my first time too."
dialogues.text: "It's okay...... It's my first time too."

dialogues.jp: 桜色の唇が小さく動く。
dialogues.en: Her pink lips moved a little.
dialogues.text: Her pink lips moved a little.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん」
dialogues.en: "Huh, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Huh, yeah."

dialogues.jp:
頷いてしまいながら、息が詰まってくるのを覚
える。
dialogues.en: I felt like suffocating as I nodded.
dialogues.text: I felt like suffocating as I nodded.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらとキス！？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kissing Sakura!?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kissing Sakura!?◆

dialogues.jp:
部屋でぼ〜っ、とマンガを読んでいると、さく
らが窓から入り込んできた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura came into my room from the window as I was reading a
manga magazine.
dialogues.text:
Sakura came into my room from the window as I was reading a
manga magazine.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま机に座るさくらと、まったりと話をし
ていたのだが、いつの間にかキスを迫られるか
たちになってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura sat on my desk and we were just talking, but then she
was demanding me to kiss her.
dialogues.text:
Sakura sat on my desk and we were just talking, but then she
was demanding me to kiss her.
